trans-unit.source: SELECT ProductionDataItems.IDSubsidiary, ProductionDataItems.IDLabourValue, SUM(ProductionDataItems.Amount) AS AmountTotal, LabourValues.LabourValueName, LabourValues.LabourValueNumber, LabourValues.TeHMin, LabourValues.Dimension, LabourValues.LabourValueDescription, CostCenters.CostCenterNo, CostCenters.CostCenterName, LabourValues.IDCostCenter, LabourValues.IDLabourValueInternal, LabourValues.WasCurrentFrom, LabourValues.WasCurrentTo, LabourValues.LastEdited, CostCenters.BaseValuePrecision, CostCenters.BaseValueSynonym, LabourValues.IsActive, LabourValues.IsCurrent FROM ProductionDataItems INNER JOIN ProductionData ON ProductionDataItems.IDSubsidiary = ProductionData.IDSubsidiary AND ProductionDataItems.IDProductionData = ProductionData.IDProductionData INNER JOIN LabourValues ON ProductionDataItems.IDLabourValue = LabourValues.IDLabourValue AND ProductionDataItems.IDSubsidiary = LabourValues.IDSubsidiary INNER JOIN CostCenters ON LabourValues.IDSubsidiary = CostCenters.IDSubsidiary AND LabourValues.IDCostCenter = CostCenters.IDCostCenter WHERE (ProductionData.ProductionDate >= @FromDate) AND (ProductionData.ProductionDate <= @ToDate) AND (ProductionData.IDSubsidiary = @IDSubsidiary) AND (ProductionData.IDWorkGroup = @IDWorkgroup) GROUP BY ProductionDataItems.IDSubsidiary, ProductionDataItems.IDLabourValue, LabourValues.LabourValueName, LabourValues.LabourValueNumber, LabourValues.TeHMin, LabourValues.Dimension, LabourValues.LabourValueDescription, CostCenters.CostCenterNo, CostCenters.CostCenterName, LabourValues.IDCostCenter, LabourValues.IDLabourValueInternal, LabourValues.WasCurrentFrom, LabourValues.WasCurrentTo, LabourValues.LastEdited, CostCenters.BaseValuePrecision, CostCenters.BaseValueSynonym, LabourValues.IsActive, LabourValues.IsCurrent
